with Velocity Capital Partners and Clarus Securities for a brokered "best efforts" private placement offering of flow-through common shares to raise up to C$13M.
The brokered offering includes BC Charity FT Shares priced at C$1.395 per share and Charity FT shares priced at C$1.305 per share.
The company also plans a separate non-brokered private placement offering of up to 1.86M flow-through shares at C$1.080 per share to raise upto C$2M.
Aggregate gross proceeds from both offerings will reach up to C$15M and will be fully allocated toward eligible critical mineral mining exploration expenses in Canada.
The company will renounce all qualifying exploration expenditures in favor of subscribers effective December 31, 2026, and provides a tax indemnity if it fails to renounce the promised amounts.
The offering is scheduled to close on or about September 30, 2026.
